# Startup readback: AI-39

Contract version: 1

## Objective and acceptance outcomes

Remaining work is to turn the existing bounded Procurement launch into a requirement-first, evidence-backed comparison with durable decision records. Acceptance outcomes: hard requirements filter candidates before ranking and unknown compatibility remains unresolved; current item, delivery and required accessory costs plus source/retrieval freshness and review uncertainty are represented explicitly; a revised saved requirement creates a linked new comparison while retaining the previous decision and evidence; any purchase/payment request stops before execution.

## Dependencies and relevant contracts

AI-15, AI-16 and AI-19 are Done. Existing entry points are the Procurement page and `OnDemandLaunchForm`, `/api/workflows/launch` and `workflow-launch`; existing storage includes `on_demand_research_runs`, `research_sources` and `procurement_recommendations`, with canonical run/report/evidence handling from AI-15/19. Procurement owns requirements, research, comparisons and lifecycle; Finance may support affordability. Integration: Using existing `workflow-launch`, on-demand run, source/evidence and report contracts; integration risks: AI-01, DB-03, DB-05, ACC-01, ACC-02, OPS-01 and PROC-01.

## Implementation and boundaries

Follow the three root specs: explicit requirements and decisive trade-offs, current cited evidence, freshness/uncertainty labels, and comparison grids; no popularity-first ranking and no autonomous purchase. Preserve authenticated user ownership, AAL2/RLS, bounded spend/search/model policy, correlation, audit and redaction. Inspect all direct producers/consumers before changing their schema. If migrations are needed, check main and active sibling PR prefixes first and add forward-only migration(s); no migration prefix or shared integration-rule/ledger changes until coordinated with the parent.

## Local tests and commands

Target deterministic contracts for requirement extraction/validation, hard-filter-before-rank, unknown compatibility, all-in integer-minor-unit cost, source freshness/review quality, revision linkage/history preservation and buy-request denial. Exercise only directly changed API/DB/Edge/browser boundaries, including SQL write constraints and caller-role/RLS paths, then run `corepack pnpm verify:changed`; PR CI is the hosted changed-surface gate.

## Hosted proof and readiness

AI-39 explicitly requires one real staging complex-comparison journey: persist requirements before ranking; show a noncompliant and unknown-compatible candidate correctly; compare all-in prices and conflicting sources; revise a requirement and retain provenance; persist selected rationale; and stop at a buy/payment request. Validate the proof producer, strict validator and consumer against the exact immutable candidate. Staging requires an authenticated visible browser; pause for the parent's operator checkpoint before any login/MFA. After merge, run the bounded affected Procurement production smoke.

## Delegation and blockers

One owner remains accountable for AI-39 through CI, staging, merge, smoke and Linear Done; no nested coding/reviewer agents. AI-15/16/19 are complete prerequisites and AI-39 blocks AI-40 and AI-52. Parent is coordinating other ticket worktrees, serial QA-doctor initialization, migration prefixes, shared rule/ledger edits and release windows. Current external gate is the real staging session/MFA, to be resumed only when the parent confirms the headed browser is ready.
